method: per-currency pillar drivers -1/0/+1 from the morning engine reads; positioning scored by the single contrarian rule from the TFF hedge-fund cut (crowded long >=90th = -1, crowded short <=10th = +1, else 0)
note: Weekend (Saturday 2am) read, 2026-10-17. Scores: policy = own-bank stance vs counterparty (gap favoring the other side is negative); positioning = contrarian only (stretched longs -1, stretched shorts +1, never a supportive base).
